title: Minneapolis Hop On Hop Off Tour
includes: Professional tour company with over 15 years' experience
4 stops for a hop-off experience at essential landmarks
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
Discover Minneapolis your way on the city’s only Hop-On Hop-Off sightseeing tour aboard a one-of-a-kind open-air bus. This guided experience lets you explore the city’s must-see attractions while enjoying fresh air, great views, and the lively energy of Minneapolis all around you. Designed for those short on time but big on seeing.

Maximize your time with 4 targeted stops where you’ll have time to hop off the bus, walk around, take photos, and dive into the history and culture of each location before hopping back on with your friendly driver-guide.

This unique hop-on hop-off tour is the only local experience that includes hop-off opportunities at the city’s top attractions.

Perfect for first-time visitors and locals alike, this small group tour offers a relaxed, engaging way to experience the city in motion.

In Jun, Jul, Aug use your open-air bus; in May and Sep use your enclosed coach bus. (The enclosed bus may be used in the event of unfavorable weather during summer months.)
